data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable movements of GBP 15.1 million, (2015: GBP 16.0 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance. These arose in respect of the following classes of business:

prior_year_events.impact_description: RITC take-on of other syndicates' reserves increased gross claims outstanding (RITC take-on shown in technical provisions), producing a large increase in ultimate claims for older underwriting years.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross favourable prior-year development of GBP 12.896m (a release), representing a c.3.94% reduction versus opening gross claims outstanding. Net of expected reinsurance recoveries the report records a GBP 15.123m net release. The release reflects favourable claims development across multiple classes (notably third party liability), while a large RITC take-on of reserves (GBP 148.677m gross) from other syndicates (notably syndicates 1965 and 2243) materially affected the older underwriting years' ultimate estimates.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable movements of GBP 15.1 million, (2015: GBP 16.0 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
The large increase in ultimate claims between three and four years later for the 2011 pure underwriting year is predominantly due to the RITC's of syndicates 1965 and 2243 in 2015.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities) - 2015 comparative column. Prior year movement uses the gross 'Change in prior year provisions' line in the Technical Provisions reconciliation (gross = (12,896) GBP '000). Narrative in the claims note quotes the NET favourable movement (GBP 15.123m) - the net figure is provided in the text but the primary gross movement is used here. A large RITC take-on (148,677 GBP '000) is present and distorts older-year development; per-class movements in the note are presented net of reinsurance, so lob_movements use net-by-class figures (lower confidence). Claims development triangle is present but distorted by RITC; triangle extraction is partial and presented in original table units (thousands).
